title: Unravel Two
description: Unravel Two is a puzzle-platformer where two Yarnys are linked together as they move through environments, swing across gaps, solve physics-based puzzles, and support each other. It can be played solo or in local co-op. Nintendo lists TV, tabletop, and handheld support, with handheld play limited to single-player.
